versions.changelog:
Initial release of DOM Observer Pro, a high-performance DOM monitoring utility for web browsers.

- Real-time detection of dynamic content using MutationObserver and IntersectionObserver
- Intelligent debouncing, batching, and throttling for optimized performance
- Selector-based targeting and ignoring for precise monitoring
- Supports extraction of text, images, and links from new elements
- Shadow DOM compatibility and browser extension readiness
- Highly configurable with JSON-based settings
